verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe shows a headless, promptless skill install: `npx -y skills add openai/plugins --skill plugin-creator -a codex -y --copy` placed a valid skill in ./.agents/skills, which Codex scans automatically. That path relies on third-party tooling, though. The first-party routes are `$skill-installer`, which takes a name or GitHub URL, and `codex plugin marketplace add`, but neither is documented as non-interactive. Plugin installs go through the interactive `/plugins` browser and need a new session before use. missing for 10: a documented first-party non-interactive install command or flag, confirmation that `$skill-installer` runs without prompts, and a headless plugin install path that needs no session restart.
